name: Continuum: Habit Streak Grid
subtitle: Daily Routine & Goal Tracker
promotionalText: Streak freezes now cover a missed day automatically, and milestone celebrations happen inside the habit card instead of taking over the screen. Year heatmap added.
description:
Three habits. Sixty-six days. One dot per day.

Continuum is a habit tracker with no account, no ads, and no subscription. Press and hold a habit to mark it done. The dot fills. That's the whole interaction.

THE GRID
Every habit gets a 66-day grid — roughly the window a behaviour takes to become automatic. You see the whole run at once: the days you showed up, the days you didn't, how far is left.

MARKING DONE
Press and hold. Haptics build under your thumb and release when the day registers. Hard to do by accident, which is the point.

STREAKS AND HEALTH
A streak counts consecutive days. A health percentage counts the recent stretch honestly — one missed day dents it, it doesn't reset it. Streak freezes cover a single missed day automatically, so a bad Tuesday doesn't erase six weeks.

MILESTONES
Days 1, 3, 5, 7, 21, 66, 100 and 365 are marked inside the habit card itself — a small animation where you're already looking, not a full-screen interruption. Day 66 is the graduation.

WIDGETS
Home screen and lock screen. Mark a habit done without opening the app.

REMINDERS
One per habit, at a time you pick, plus a single 8pm alert if a streak is about to break. Completed habits are never pinged.

THE REST
A year heatmap per habit. Share cards. iCloud sync across your devices. Dark, monospaced, deliberately plain.

No social feed. No streak you can buy back.
